280.note_text: 1. An ancillary device may or may not be subject to legal metrology control according to its function in the measuring system or to national regulations. 2. An ancillary device may be integrated into the calculator, into the meter, or constitutes peripheral equipment linked to the calculator by means of an interface.

278.note_text: device, other than the main indicating device, connected to a calculator, intended to perform a particular function, directly involved in elaborating, transmitting or displaying measurement results Main ancillary devices are: - repeating indicating device; - printing device; - memory device; - totalizing indicating device; - conversion device.
